faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Yadgir District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Yadgir District Court Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Typist posts?
faq.answer: For the Typist and Typist Copyist posts, candidates must have completed PUC or a 3-year Diploma or equivalent qualification. Additionally, they need to possess Senior Grade Typing skills in both Kannada and English languages.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies are available for the posts of Typist, Typist Copyist, and Process Server in the Yadgir District Court Recruitment 2026. Specific numbers for each post are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 200/-. For SC/ST candidates, the fee is Rs. 50/-. No fee is mentioned for women applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Yadgir District Court Recruitment 2026 primarily involves a Typing Test in both Kannada and English, followed by Document Verification for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Typist and Typist Copyist positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Typist and Typist Copyist posts will receive a monthly salary in the pay scale of Rs. 34,100 to Rs. 67,600.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification is for Yadgir District Court in Karnataka. While the official notification should be checked for specific state domicile requirements, typically government jobs are open to eligible candidates across India, subject to fulfilling all criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. How should I pay the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee can be paid online through the application portal. Specific payment methods and instructions will be available on the official website and within the detailed notification.
